envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: every agent already holds a role in canon; the omp projection dropped it, so every subagent inherited the parent's model and no position could be routed
envelope.cause: operator asked why subagents don't use omp roles; approved projecting held roles with a @default fallback and seeding missing roles at install

payload.gloss: the position an agent holds, carried to a harness as the key its host routes a model by. Each agent's projected definition names the role it holds as a model-role alias, followed by the harness's default role as the fallback, so a host that never configured the role runs the agent as before. Install adds, for every held role the host lacks, an entry aliasing the harness's nearest built-in role (on omp: implementer to task, planner to plan, assayer and architect to default), never changes an entry the host has set, and reports what it added. Which model fills a role is the host's choice; the projection names no model.
